title: i495_route
description: Resolves origin/destination (label or node id) against the within-495 subset of oracles/i95.json, Transurban's own published Express Lanes network, to the od_pair_id into trip_pricing_i95 -- then prices that key over RDS as of at_time (default: now, America/New_York), returning the most recently published row at or before that time. Unlike i95_route, no availability gate is applied: VDOT never reports a meaningful link_status for the 495 Express Lanes (they aren't reversible). A trip that crosses into the 95/395 Express Lanes is out of scope -- see i95_route.json for that facility; the two tools never combine into a single cross-corridor price. Design: docs/oracle-tools-spec.md; version enforced by tests/test_tool_schemas.py.

origin.description: Ramp label (e.g. 'Route 267'), case-insensitive, or the oracle's raw node id as a fallback.

at_time.description: ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g. '2026-07-26T14:32:00' or with an explicit UTC offset); a value with no offset is assumed America/New_York. Defaults to now (America/New_York) if omitted. The price returned is the most recently published row at or before this time, never the price this instant -- VDOT's own feed trails real-time by roughly 10-20 minutes (docs/oracle-findings.md section 7); priced_as_of exposes exactly how stale.

origin.description: Echoes the caller's raw input string.

destination.description: Echoes the caller's raw input string.

at_time.description: The resolved, ISO-8601 time actually used for pricing (the caller's at_time, or now in America/New_York if omitted).

legs.description: Exactly one priced leg -- every within-495 oracle pair is single-leg.

corridor_name.description: VDOT's own corridor_name -- the only two values this tool's oracle filter should ever produce.

priced_as_of.description: ISO-8601 interval_end_at of the trip_pricing_i95 row actually used -- typically earlier than at_time, since that row is the most recent one published at or before it.

error.description: Unknown origin/destination identifier (including a cross-corridor destination on the 95/395 side, which this tool never resolves), no direct trip between a known pair, an ambiguous match (unreachable today), a malformed at_time, or no priced row found for the resolved od_pair_id in trip_pricing_i95 at or before at_time.

valid_options.description: Non-empty only for resolution errors, where it lists self-correction candidates (the full ramp label list on an unknown identifier, or the reachable destination labels from a known origin). Empty for a malformed at_time or a pricing miss, since retrying the same inputs won't fix either.
